terrain.creator: Tom Patterson / Natural Earth III
terrain.limitations: Normalized relative elevation used only for visual shaded relief; not metres, a DEM for movement, landcover, or historical terrain.

surfaceAtlas.channels: R: unchanged relative elevation; G: ocean distance to bundled country coastlines, capped at 24 pixels; B: country land mask; A: opaque
surfaceAtlas.coastSource: Bundled Natural Earth v5.1.2 world.geojson; public domain
surfaceAtlas.limitations: Coastal distance is illustrative shelf colour, not bathymetry. Biome colours are latitude/elevation-based artistic styling, not land-cover data.
surfaceAtlas.rendering: Original geographic-space procedural meadow, forest canopy, agricultural mosaic and rocky ridge shading; multi-octave derivative filtering maintains stable detail from tactical zoom to globe. No satellite imagery or asset-library textures imported.
